acceptance_criteria.criterion: governance-reconcile completion immediately triggers a live-state sweep of open prs; default-branch workflow sha is never treated as a candidate head
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py:25 and :471-472: reconcile completion triggers open_pull_requests() sweep; reconcile head_sha never fed to open_prs_for_head. tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py::test_governance_reconcile_completion_sweeps_open_pull_requests arms open_prs_for_head to raise AssertionError('default-branch SHA is not a candidate head'), proving unreachable. tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_convergence.py::test_property_27_readiness_is_never_published_against_a_base_sha.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ordinary dependency completions remain attributed to their exact candidate head
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py:480-482: ordinary workflow completion without PR association resolves candidate via workflow_run.head_sha verbatim. tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py::test_ordinary_workflow_completion_without_association_uses_exact_head asserts open_prs_for_head receives the exact head_sha. tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_convergence.py::test_workflow_run_without_associations_recovers_candidates_by_head.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: unresolved review threads and fixed blocking threads without an evidence-bearing reply cannot satisfy ready/merge state
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py:341-342: unresolved threads produce Decision('failure'). scripts/hunter_pre_ready_review.py:906-912: resolved findings require structured resolution_evidence (exact correction commit SHA plus committed regression test). tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py::test_unresolved_review_thread_blocks; tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_a_resolved_finding_must_carry_structured_resolution_evidence; tests/test_hunter_reviewer_disposition.py::test_unresolved_validated_finding_cannot_be_resolved_by_thread_resolution_alone.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: detection never resolves a github thread automatically and does not block non-blocking review suggestions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py:106-136: unresolved_review_threads() is a read-only GraphQL query (reads isResolved, paginates on hasNextPage/endCursor); grep across scripts/ found no resolveReviewThread mutation. tests/hunter_readiness_harness.py:181: thread resolver exists only in the test harness. tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_an_unresolved_non_blocking_finding_does_not_block_ready.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: historical findings are mapped to an existing family or added only with verified source, correction, regression test, and applicability
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/HISTORICAL_DEFECT_BACKFILL.json records the inspected window (PRs #438, #443, #444, #450, #453, #466, #468): 12 confirmed issues mapped to DFF-013/018/019/020/021/022/023, 2 style and 1 false-positive exclusions. scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py:489 validate_historical_defect_backfill fails closed when a confirmed record lacks a registry family with regression evidence, issue selector, and gate reference. tests/test_historical_defect_backfill.py proves the canonical artifact valid plus negative fixtures for unmapped families, unresolved references, and duplicates.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: applicable known-defect regression selectors are deterministic, deduplicated, and fail closed when evidence is missing or fails
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pre_ready_review.py:272-287 load_families fails closed on missing/unreadable registry; :290-311 applicable_family_ids returns tuple(sorted(...)) deterministic, one entry per family; :855-868 verify_claims fails closed on missing applicable families. scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py:197 _validate_reference_target rejects unresolvable selectors. tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_a_review_cannot_narrow_its_own_applicability; tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_duplicate_family_identities_are_refused.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the pre-push boundary does not run the full repository suite; hosted pre-pr remains its sole owner
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pr_preflight.py:23-31 PUSH_SAFETY_GATES = NORMAL_QUALITY_GATES[:-1] excludes Pytest. scripts/hunter_pre_push.py:124-131 _run_push_safety_lane runs only Artifact Guard, Defect Prevention Guard, Ruff, Black, Mypy. docs/VALIDATION_STAGE_CONTRACT.md:58 pre-push-safety boundary states 'never' for the full suite. tests/test_hunter_pre_push.py::test_normal_mode_runs_the_push_safety_lane_rather_than_the_full_repository_suite asserts PYTEST_GATE not in PUSH_SAFETY_GATES.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: adversarial tests cover stale events, missing associations, pagination/api uncertainty, path-prefix traps, duplicate selectors, and invalid evidence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Stale events: tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_convergence.py::test_property_15_stale_pending_is_replaced_by_the_current_terminal_state, tests/test_validation_proof_reuse.py::test_stale_receipt_fails_closed. Missing associations: tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py::test_ordinary_workflow_completion_without_association_uses_exact_head. Path-prefix traps: tests/test_hunter_reviewer_disposition.py::test_reference_paths_are_confined_after_symlink_resolution, tests/test_hunter_workflow_state.py::test_scope_entries_match_by_directory_prefix_and_glob. Duplicate selectors: tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_duplicate_family_identities_are_refused; tests/test_historical_defect_backfill.py negative fixtures reject unknown classification/status, unmapped duplicates, and unresolvable reference targets. Invalid evidence: tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_a_family_cannot_claim_regression_tested_without_a_resolvable_test. Pagination/fail-closed: tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py::test_ready_admission_fails_closed_when_review_evidence_is_unavailable, tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness.py::test_infrastructure_unavailable_fails_closed_with_typed_pending.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no merge occurs without explicit owner approval
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/VALIDATION_STAGE_CONTRACT.md:249: auto-merge, auto-mark Ready, or merge without human owner approval is forbidden. scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py rejects connector write ingress with auto_merge is not False. tests/test_validation_stage_contract.py::test_merge_control_stages_remain_human_terminated asserts human['boundary']=='human'. tests/test_code_write_policy.py:171 auto_merge must be False; :232 flipping to True is refused.
